commits.message:
fix(resume): AI calls fail fast with a clear message; ATS template formatting, spacing and page limit

- AI model calls: one bounded 40 s attempt, no retry of a timeout, short queue wait, and a circuit breaker (fail at once for 45 s after 2 upstream failures) so a down LiteLLM gateway no longer hangs requests past the proxy limit (browser saw 'Failed to fetch')
- ATS template: no stray separators in the contact line, no empty section headings, section markers for highlighting, roomier spacing
- maxPages (1-4) overrides the length profile on measure/export/export-from
- Resume create accepts a label (master resume)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume): create from an uploaded file; versions keep the job's keywords

- POST /resume/import/file: PDF/DOCX -> structured resume (owner, or a bench-sales user for a managed consultant), rate limited, upload never kept
- Tailored versions store the posting's keywords as their target job
- Resume create accepts a label (master)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(resume): page limits up to 8, richer certifications in the file, credential and readability checks

- maxPages accepts 1-8 (advisory above 4: recruiters read the first two pages closely)
- Certifications carry expiry, credential ID and a plain-text verification link in the PDF/Word/text exports (no images, which ATS skip)
- New checks: expired credential, missing issuer or date, too many bullets for a role, no LinkedIn address

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Certification catalog (LLM-enriched, usage-ranked, generated badges) and page layout customization

- layout: section order, hidden sections, spacing, text size across html/txt/docx renderers

- resume create/list/summary/achievements accept employers (org-scoped via the consultants module)

Address PR review: catalog integrity, SQL search, opt-in interactive AI mode, assignment hardening

Certification catalog
- Count distinct people (certification_choice, unique per person and entry), so one user can no longer make an
  entry public or trigger enrichment (H1, D6).
- Atomic upsert and increment inside one transaction; no lost counts, no P2002 500 (H2, H3).
- Enrichment re-keys the slug and merges into an existing entry instead of duplicating it (H4); a lease column
  makes one request enrich an entry at a time (A5).
- Search filters in SQL on a normalised search column (H6); the badge is drawn on request, so badgeSvg is dropped (D2).
- Hashed slug (D5), CHECK constraints for status/source (D1), NOT NULL aliases (D4), better indexes (D3), DTOs (C1, C2),
  badge marks skip filler words (C11).

Hermes
- Interactive mode (40 s timeout, no timeout retry, shared breaker, 20 s queue wait) is opt-in per call; background
  callers keep the old behaviour and cannot trip the breaker (H5).

Employers and assignment
- Index on resumes.consultantProfileId and a joined summary query instead of an unbounded IN list (M1, M2).
- Assignment has its own rate-limit budget and skips the repeated owner lookups (M6, M7); access is re-checked after the
  write and undone if the assignment vanished; assignment access is tagged and removed when the recruiter is
  unassigned (M5).
- File uploads from employers always resolve the organization in the guard (M10); import uses the standard error
  envelope (M9); cheap role check runs first (C6); typed request/actor (C5), comments and title fallback (C3, C7, C8).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Close the deferred review items: org-level resume access, moderation, sweeper, shared breaker, service split

- A1/M3/M4: a member of the employer organization that manages a consultant (active, with bench:edit or owner) acts
  as owner of that consultant's resumes whoever made them: roleFor, collaborator management, getOwned, assign. The
  employer's list and the summary now count the same set. Answers are cached for 15 s.
- A2: access handed over by an assignment only counts while the recruiter still represents the consultant (checked
  at read time, so it cannot outlive the assignment even without the unassign hook).
- A5/D8: claim lease + a sweeper (every 10 min) retries entries whose enrichment never finished; unrecognised entries
  nobody chose for 90 days are removed daily.
- A6/A7: admin API (crm_admin) to review, correct, hide, merge and delete catalogue entries and to remove one
  person's choices; new 'hidden' status and a review queue (model-verified entries from people, not yet reviewed).
- D7: seed certifications are loaded by a generated migration, not at application start-up
  (scripts/gen-certification-seed-migration.ts).
- M11: when one instance opens the Hermes breaker it sets a shared flag (Redis), so the others fail fast too.
- M8/C9: one shared file-reading pipeline for onboarding and the builder's import; ResumeService split into
  ResumeService, ConsultantResumeService (summary, assign) and ResumeImportService.
- C4: layout options in one module, with a test that the JSON schema lists the same values.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(pulse): address review findings on PR 55

Migration moved after main's history; indexes, job foreign key and a partial
unique index added. Send caps and cooldown re-checked inside the transaction
under advisory locks, plus a per-company weekly ceiling. Company owners and
admins can start a requirement from a company job, and activeSignalId is
scoped to the caller. Reposting a title keeps its cooldown. Audience matching
is bounded and ignores deleted companies; own-bench recruiters now receive
requirements. X-Org-Id is validated and selects the company. DTO nesting,
UUID params, publish-as-job gate and rate type, job sync config, comments,
empty-update version bump and abuse logging fixed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(pulse): finish the deferred review items

Managed consultants are stored by profile id and account id separately, so
outcomes join through the person's account and Messenger only gets an account
id. Accepting a request reports through an optional introduction port the
Network stack can provide. The job and consultant pickers are paged, the
hourly job sweep runs in batches, and outcomes moved to their own file.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #55 from jobfynder-admin/feat/pulse-on-main

feat(pulse): Open Pulse and capped Broadcast on main, with Employer team access

fix(users): close the unclaimed-contact gaps found in review

Profile email changes use findFirst on claimed accounts (the unique lookup
would fail at runtime now that email is not unique). Slug lookups, slug
reservation, messenger search and participants, collaborator lookup and
UsersService.find by email only match claimed accounts. The migration adds a
CHECK so a claimed row always has an email and a slug, indexes
claimedByUserId, drops the unused isClaimed index, and moves after main's
latest migration. Relations set onDelete SetNull. AuthUser and the bench
recruiter card keep null emails as null. Regression tests cover each lookup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
